verdict.rationale: OpenClaw's install docs list an installer script, npm/pnpm/bun packages, and an optional Docker setup. The getting-started guide promises install, onboarding, and a first chat in about 5 minutes. Missing for 10: the actual one-line install command is not quoted in the evidence, and no independent hands-on report confirms the minutes-to-chat claim (one community comparison only implies OpenClaw is easier to set up than NanoClaw).

support.subject: As a self-hoster, I can install the assistant on my own machine with one documented command — installer script, npm/pip package, or Docker image — and reach a working chat in minutes
